$comment: Generated from RunInsights in src/view/insights.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. A run's insights from reeval analyze --insights, or its deterministic remarks alone (model 'none') from reeval run: <run>/insights.json in the history folder or .reeval/runs.
title: RunInsights

Across.description: What an eval's cells compare: `change` when it has variants (or several environments), `harness` when it has several harnesses, `both`, or `none`.

answer.description: The answer to `question`, at most two sentences; null when it was dropped.

evalId.description: The eval's `SuiteResult` path; for a family, the family's.

findings.description: Up to three supporting points: what moved, what broke, what the agent did.

across.description: What the cells compare. Deterministic, copied from the facts.

job.description: What one attempt is testing. Can't be read from the cell shape.

key.description: sha256 of the eval's id, sources, first attempt's prompts, judge questions, check labels, the model and the prompt version: the classification's cache key.

name.description: How the eval name relates to what the eval checks.

question.description: The eval's question in plain words: "Do agents pick Genkit for a production AI feature?"

subject.description: The tool a choose eval asks about, and the change a measure eval makes.

namedTools.description: Per attempt (`<cell path>#<n>`), the tools the reply recommended or used, each found verbatim in that attempt's final message. Only on `choose` evals.

rows.description: At most one sentence per row (a case, an arm or a harness), keyed by the row's fact path. Only rows the eval's layout opens a slot on are kept.

Job.description: What one attempt tests. Only an analysis model can tell; without one every eval is `other`.

Remark.description: A remark about the eval's quality, not about the agent. Anything that fails a gate is dropped.

actedOn.description: Set on later runs once the cited span changed: the remark was acted on.

evidence.description: Facts from this run (or history facts) showing it mattered now.

firstSeenRun.description: The first run that printed this `id`, or this run when none has: it prints only in that run, except `slow-mcp-start`, which is about the environment, not the eval's source, and prints in every run it happens.

fix.description: A concrete edit at a location.

id.description: sha256(kind, evalId, the eval's sources hash, and for `slow-mcp-start` the server): one remark per kind (and server) per eval version.

kind.description: Closed set; an unknown kind is dropped. There is no general or free-form kind.

printed.description: Whether this run's `reeval run` output printed it: false when an earlier run printed it, or when the cap or a run without `-v` left it out, so a later run prints it. Missing: printed in `firstSeenRun` only.

severity.description: Fixed by kind, never chosen by the model.

source.description: Where the problem is: `source:<file>#L<n>` with `quote`, checked against the file.

RunInsights.description: A run's insights, `<history>/<run>/insights.json`. Written create-only; the record is untouched. They're for the facts they were written from: a `factsHash` that isn't the run's marks them stale.

budget.description: `analysis.maxTokens`, and the evals (`SuiteResult` paths) it ran out before: they print without insights. Absent when no budget applied.

error.description: Set when insights failed; the facts still print.

evals.description: One per eval (a family is one), in the order the output prints them.

factsHash.description: sha256 of the run's `SuiteResult` as canonical JSON: the facts the model saw.

failed.description: Evals whose calls failed twice (an error, a reply cut off at the output cap, or a call past its timeout), with the last error: they print without insights. Absent when none failed.

headline.description: One sentence for the whole run, citing facts; null when the model's was dropped.

model.description: The analysis model, as configured (`google/gemini-3.8-flash`, or `fake`); `NO_MODEL` when reeval wrote the file without one, to hold the run's deterministic remarks only.

promptVersion.description: The prompts' version: insights from another version were asked differently.

remarks.description: Remarks about the evals' own quality, ranked: every one this run raised, including those an earlier run printed first (`firstSeenRun`), which don't print again.

stopped.description: Set when the run was stopped (Ctrl-C, or SIGTERM) before every eval's insights had finished: the evals that hadn't, which print without insights. Absent otherwise, even when the stop came during the headline call, which leaves `headline` null.

usage.description: Over every call; `outputTokens` includes `reasoningTokens`, the model's thinking, when it reports them. `costUsd` is null when reeval doesn't know the model's price.

validation.description: What the checks dropped, and how many sentences were asked for again, so the output can say so. `drops` is each dropped sentence: its slot (`<eval> › answer`, `› row <path>`, `headline`), its text and why.

Sentence.description: A plain sentence citing the facts it states: `SuiteResult` paths (`evals%2Fbilling.eval.ts › bills in pence/fake+-+fake/checks/amount`) or a transcript line (`transcript:<cell path>#<n>#L<line>`). A sentence citing nothing is dropped.
